voice.modesSubtitle: Choose how you want to train today. Warm up freely or test your instincts in structured roleplay.

spontaneous.title: Free talk & acoustic sparring
spontaneous.description: Open-ended sparring with no predefined script. The AI dynamically adapts to any topic, challenging your phrasing, pausing cadence, and natural idioms.

structured.title: Executive roleplay scenarios
structured.description: High-stakes workplace simulations with realistic partner personas. Practice sprint pushbacks, system architecture defenses, salary negotiations, and executive presentations.
structured.feature2: CEFR B1 to C1 difficulty calibration

custom.dialogBody: Describe the situation; the partner persona is optional.

room.spaceHint: Press Space to toggle the microphone
room.freeTalkObjective: Open-ended sparring with no predefined script. The AI adapts to whatever you bring.
room.transcriptEmpty: Your live transcript will appear here once you start speaking.
room.briefTip1: · Speak naturally — the partner adapts to your phrasing.

guide.title: How voice sparring works
guide.subtitle: Speak freely through your scenario. Review the live transcript, fix misrecognized words, and tap any turn for annotated feedback and better phrasing.

step1.title: Speak naturally into your mic
step1.body: Use %icon% to talk. The circular visualizer follows the conversation audio in real time.

step2.title: Live transcript & turn analysis
step2.body: Your dialogue appears in the transcript stream as you speak. Tap %icon% on any turn to see annotated delivery and phrasing upgrades.

step3.title: Tap pencil to clarify recognized words
step3.body: If a word was misheard, tap %icon% on your turn to fix it by typing or re-recording. The mic stays muted while you clarify.

step4.title: Upgrade phrasing & analyze again
step4.body: Each analysis suggests replacements that elevate your wording. Re-speak and run %icon% to compare.

recovery.title: Clarify your message
recovery.subtitle: Type your correction directly or tap re-record to speak again.
recovery.helper: Feel free to edit the sentence above or clear it to start over.
recovery.recordUnsupported: Recording is not supported in this browser.
